tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the workspace and token for the bearer credential, and the credits left this month.

tools.name: parse_document
tools.description: Extract structured fields from a PDF, PNG, JPEG, or text file sent as base64 in file_base64, or from plain text sent in text (10 MB and 10 pages on Free, 25 MB on Starter and Pro, 100 MB on Business; pages per document by plan: Starter 50, Pro 200, Business 500). 1 credit per page; an image is 1 pag

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List the extraction layouts saved in this workspace.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Read one saved extraction layout by slug.

tools.name: create_schema
tools.description: Save an extraction layout in this workspace. The slug (API id) is derived from the display name. A layout is {"type":"object","properties":{...}}. Each property is {"type":T} where T is one of any, null, boolean, string, number, date, array, object. An optional description, at most 400 characters, t

tools.name: update_schema
tools.description: Update a saved layout's display name and/or definition. A layout is {"type":"object","properties":{...}}. Each property is {"type":T} where T is one of any, null, boolean, string, number, date, array, object. An optional description, at most 400 characters, tells the model how to read that key. An o

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List the inboxes this key can see, newest first, up to 200. Each has its id, name, icon, status, document count and email address. A key limited to some inboxes sees only those.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Read one inbox: its name, icon, status, document count, email address, and its fields as a JSON schema (schema, null for a draft with no fields yet). The fields show what kind of document the inbox reads, so use them to decide which inbox a document belongs in.

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Add one document to an inbox. It is read with the inbox's fields in the background, the same as a document dropped into the inbox in the console, and costs 1 credit per page. Send the file as file_base64 (a PDF, PNG or JPEG) with its file_name. Returns the new document's id. Upload only to the inbox

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create an inbox in this workspace and return its id and email address. Send template (a built-in template slug: invoice, receipt, bank_statement, purchase_order) to make it ACTIVE with that template's fields, the same as creating one in the console. Without a template it is a DRAFT that does not par

tools.name: create_inbox_from_schema
tools.description: Create an active inbox from a schema you send, in the same format as a saved layout. The inbox gets its own fields, its email address is returned, and mail and uploads are parsed at once. This path is for the API and MCP only; the console does not offer it.

tools.name: update_inbox
tools.description: Change an inbox's name and/or icon. Send name, icon, or both. Send icon as null to go back to the default icon. Renaming does not change the email address.

tools.name: get_inbox_email
tools.description: Read an inbox's email address and whether it accepts mail. The address is created the first time it is read.

tools.name: set_inbox_email_enabled
tools.description: Turn mail receiving on or off for one inbox. The address does not change. Documents already in the inbox are not affected.

tools.name: set_inbox_webhook
tools.description: Save where an inbox sends each parsed document, so documents that arrive by email or upload reach your system without a poll. Each body is signed with the returned secret. An empty url turns the webhook off. Only a key created by the workspace owner can change it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_inboxes, get_inbox, upload_document, get_inbox_email · Private data: whoami, parse_document, list_inboxes, get_inbox, upload_document, set_inbox_email_enabled, set_inbox_webhook · Public sink: parse_document, list_inboxes, get_inbox, upload_document, create_inbox, create_inbox_from_schema, update_inbox, get_inbox_email, set_inbox_email_enabled, set_inbox_webhook · Destructive: create_inbox_from_schema.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_inboxes, get_inbox, upload_document, get_inbox_email · Private data: whoami, parse_document, list_inboxes, get_inbox, upload_document, set_inbox_email_enabled, set_inbox_webhook · Public sink: parse_document, list_inboxes, get_inbox, upload_document, create_inbox, create_inbox_from_schema, update_inbox, get_inbox_email, set_inbox_email_enabled, set_inbox_webhook · Destructive: create_inbox_from_schema

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
